"""Round 3. Use the simulated round 2 oil and water responses to correct early water influx at P15/P16."""
from datetime import datetime
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import numpy as np
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(1, str(ROOT.parent))
from compositional_tools import fields
from spatial_tools import native_fields, well_region, path_region
from field_edit import save_candidate

reference = fields(ROOT / "candidates/round1_k_only")
indices, xyz, connections = native_fields()
sw0 = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/initial_ImmiscibleSaturation.bin")
volume = np.fromfile(ROOT / "runs/baseline_tuned/volumes.bin")
paths = np.load(ROOT / "topology/bottom_completion_paths.npz")
safe = (sw0 < .99) & (reference["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume > 1e-3)
log_h = np.zeros(len(indices)); log_z = log_h.copy(); log_phi = log_h.copy()
controls = {
    "P11": {"kh": 1., "kz": 3., "phi": .75},
    "P12": {"kh": 2.5, "kz": 2., "phi": .70},
    "P13": {"kh": 1., "kz": 2., "phi": .85},
    "P14": {"kh": 3., "kz": 2., "phi": .50},
    "P15": {"kh": 3., "kz": 1.75, "phi": .72},
    "P16": {"kh": 4., "kz": 1., "phi": .95},
}
for well, control in controls.items():
    path_weight = path_region(xyz, paths[well], horizontal_radius_m=220, vertical_radius_m=30)
    log_z += np.log(control["kz"]) * path_weight
    log_phi += np.log(control["phi"]) * path_weight * safe
    if well in {"P14", "P15", "P16"}:
        deepest = connections.loc[connections.well == well, "z"].max()
        near = well_region(xyz, connections, well, radius_m=220, vertical_padding_m=45)
        lower = .5 * (1 + np.tanh((xyz[2] - (deepest - 60.)) / 20.))
        weight = np.maximum(path_weight, near * lower)
    else:
        weight = path_weight
    log_h += np.log(control["kh"]) * weight
changed = {}
for key, factor in [("PERMX", np.exp(log_h)), ("PERMY", np.exp(log_h)),
                    ("PERMZ", np.exp(log_z)), ("PORO", np.exp(log_phi))]:
    value = reference[key].copy(); value.ravel()[indices] *= factor; changed[key] = value
rationale = {
    "decision_time": datetime.now().isoformat(),
    "objective": "Full-period field and well oil and water rates. Pressure and gas are diagnostic and the final period has no extra weight.",
    "feedback": "results/round2_oil_water_comparison_day1281.json and the actual response from diagnostics_round2_1281. Coverage ends at day 1281; this is a window-specific comparison.",
    "p14_retention_rationale": "Over the same partial window, water-rate RMSE fell from 218.39 m3/day at baseline and 170.77 in round one to 62.77 in round two. Retain the round-two settings for P14 and check the full history for excessive late-time water.",
    "p15_revision_rationale": "On day 1281 the observed water rate was 86.35 m3/day and round two gave 365.13 m3/day, indicating early water arrival. Reduce the multiplier on lower-zone Kh from 5 to 3 and the additional Kz multiplier from 3 to 1.75. Restore pathway porosity from 0.55 to 0.72 times the original value to delay the front and reduce early water supply.",
    "p16_revision_rationale": "On day 1281 the observed water rate was 4.97 m3/day and round two gave 51.11 m3/day. Sw was 0.336 at the deepest completion and 0.244 in the adjacent upper layer. Kz remained very low in several layers, indicating mainly along-layer water entry. Retain Kz, reduce the Kh enhancement from 8 to 4 and restore porosity from 0.65 to 0.95 times the original value to test front timing along the layer.",
    "other_wells": "Retain the round-two settings for P11, P12 and P13. Errors change little during the current low-water-cut period. Later low water production requires full-history evaluation.",
    "central_multipliers": controls,
    "multiplier_reference": "Kh and Kz are relative to round1_k_only, and porosity to the original porosity. Compared with round two, only the P15 and P16 influence regions change. The length scales and path definitions are identical.",
    "region": "As in round two, use Gaussian bottom-water path scales of 220 m horizontally and 30 m vertically; use the lower 60 m near the well with a smooth 20 m transition. Combine regions by maximum weight to avoid repeated multiplication.",
    "path_scope": "Use a static 1/T query on positive-transmissibility discrete connections. Check it against time-varying Sw and production curves; it does not establish an observed dynamic streamline.",
    "porosity_constraints": "Active cells that initially contain hydrocarbons and have pore volume > 1e-3 m3. Preserve pore volume in pure-water regions and retain the cell mapping.",
    "initial_composition": "Retain the original normalized composition. Fractions are nonnegative and sum to one in every cell.",
    "fixed_conditions": "Retain EOS, SCAL, well controls and completions, initial pressure and Sw, temperature, grid and simulator source.",
    "pore_volume_original_m3": float(np.sum(reference["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "pore_volume_edited_m3": float(np.sum(changed["PORO"].ravel()[indices] * volume)),
    "full_verification": "Rerun 516 report intervals over 2891 days from t0. Make the final selection using full-period oil and water metrics; partial windows support diagnosis.",
}
print(save_candidate("round3_timing", changed, rationale, parent="round2_oil_water"))
(ROOT / "round3_decision.json").write_text(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps(rationale, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
